def: properly, shut up, i.e. the breast (as enclosing the heart); also gold (as generally shut up safely)

occurrences.text: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
